[[File:Czerka_Experimental_Combat_Enhancer_Mk_2.png|thumb|right|100px|Czerka Experimental Combat Enhancer Mk. 2]]
The '''Czerka Experimental Combat Enhancer Mk. 2''' was a combat enhancement boost developed by the [[Czerka Interstellar]] during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="Trial by Firepower">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=event|Galactic Season 9: Trial by Firepower}}</ref> It was the upgraded version of the [[Czerka Phase Three Adrenal Combat Enhancers|original adrenal boost]] created by Czerka, designed to provide users with even more various buffs.<ref name="Season 9">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20250818|text=Galactic Seasons 9 "Flashpoint Resurgence"}}</ref> Around [[3622 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.7.1}} 7.7.1: Flashpoint Resurgence can be placed around [[3622 BBY]].</ref> [[Kai Zykken]] established an uplink with the [[Alliance Commander]] and offered the new top-grade Czerka combat boost for testing. Zykken described the combat boost as the most stable stims anyone in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] had ever seen.<ref name="Trial by Firepower" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Czerka Experimental Combat Enhancer Mk. 2 was a usable item first appeared in Game Update 7.7.1 "Flashpoint Resurgence," released on [[August 19]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'', the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref> The item is only usable inside of Flashpoints, a four-player instanced group missions with story-driven objectives and combat encounters.<ref name="Item">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=item|Czerka Experimental Combat Enhancer Mk. 2|[[Ki'at Thavo]]}}</ref>
